segments.text: 16 Then Daniel whoſe name was Beltſazar, held hys peace by the ſpace of one houre, and hys thoughtes troubled hym, and the king ſpake and ſayd: Beltſazar, let neyther the dreame nor the interpretation thereof trouble thee. Beltſazar aunſwered and ſayd: my Lord, the dreame be to them that hate thee, and the interpretation therof to thine enemyes.
